description: Move one or more objects to a different layer. Objects that are found are moved; missing UUIDs are listed in notFound and per-object failures in errors (success is false if either is non-empty). Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to foreground) during execution.

position.description: beginning = front of layer, end = back of layer

target_layer.description: Target top-level layer name. If several layers share the name, the topmost one is used and a warning is returned

name: move_to_layer
title: Move to Layer
